title: Omarchy Mobile is written, and the phone is restarting
body: Every image was written, and the phone confirmed each one: boot_b, init_boot_b, vendor_boot_b, vendor_kernel_boot_b, dtbo_b, userdata.

Slot B is the active slot, and the phone was told to restart. It now starts Omarchy Mobile from slot B. At its first start the system grows to fill the phone's storage and sets up your account from your answers, which can take a few minutes. Then it starts into your account, locked: unlock it with your PIN or password.

The radio backup and Google's files for Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound, camera and modem are not on the phone: this version of the installer does nothing after the restart. So Wi-Fi does not connect yet; the network you gave is kept for when it does.
footer: Android is still on slot A, unused. Its data was erased with userdata, so it needs a factory reset if it is ever started again.
The install guide's "Going back to Android" has the steps to put the phone back as it was sold.
